# stapel-react — llms.txt index

34/39 packages describe their own surface in llms.txt as of this build.

Generated by `scripts/gen-root-llms.mjs` from the curated lines in `scripts/root-llms-groups.mjs`, each package's package.json and its llms.txt presence. Do not edit by hand.

An agent that does not yet know which package it needs reads this ONE file, picks a name below, then reads that package's full surface (exports, hooks, operations, errors) at `packages/<name without @stapel/>/llms.txt` — `@stapel/auth-react` is `packages/auth-react/llms.txt`.

Every package here is headless in its main entry — a line below says what the package does, never how it looks. ``_(+ `/default` skin)_`` marks the ones that ALSO ship an opt-in antd skin on a `/default` subpath; which slots that skin fills, and any further subpath, is in that package's own llms.txt.

## Described (34), by domain

### Accounts and people (4)

- **@stapel/auth-react** — sign-in flows (OTP, password, OAuth, TOTP, passkeys, magic link, QR, SSO), sessions, step-up
- **@stapel/profiles-react** — my profile and public profiles, avatar upload, follow/block, contacts, setup gate
- **@stapel/workspaces-react** — workspaces, members, invitations, capabilities and capability gates, audit
- **@stapel/gdpr-react** — account closure with its grace, entity erasure, pending deletions, data export, DSAR intake _(+ `/default` skin)_

### Catalog and commerce (10)

- **@stapel/listings-react** — listing composer, listing page (with the page.actions slot), owner dashboard, favourites, share _(+ `/default` skin)_
- **@stapel/categories-react** — category tree, revision-delta sync, category pages _(+ `/default` skin)_
- **@stapel/attributes-react** — value editors and renderers for dynamic feature types in a category schema _(+ `/default` skin)_
- **@stapel/vocabularies-react** — term typeahead and code-to-label resolve for large reference vocabularies
- **@stapel/search-react** — search client, URL-first filter state, result and facet hooks _(+ `/default` skin)_
- **@stapel/orders-react** — cart, idempotent checkout, order history, add-to-cart embed for a listing page _(+ `/default` skin)_
- **@stapel/currencies-react** — money formatting and conversion per locale and currency
- **@stapel/billing-react** — wallet of expiring credit lots, holds and debts; catalog, checkout, subscriptions, transactions _(+ `/default` skin)_
- **@stapel/reviews-react** — ratings and reviews of any (target_type, target_key) _(+ `/default` skin)_
- **@stapel/geo-react** — location picker: map, search-as-you-type, browser position, draggable pin

### Content and media (7)

- **@stapel/docs-react** — documents with snapshot saves, the editor_hint registry, sharing _(+ `/default` skin)_
- **@stapel/drive-react** — phone-first drive over docs: starred, recents, search, thumbnails, share sheet, uploads
- **@stapel/forms-react** — form fill, builder, responses and settings _(+ `/default` skin)_
- **@stapel/cdn-react** — dedup-first media upload client (hash, exists check, upload) _(+ `/default` skin)_
- **@stapel/recordings-react** — recordings list, upload, player, transcript with payload-driven polling
- **@stapel/video-react** — per-scope video usage by calendar month _(+ `/default` skin)_
- **@stapel/translate-react** — remote locales and text translation

### Communication and work (5)

- **@stapel/chat-react** — chat threads with a seq-ordered store behind one transport seam _(+ `/default` skin)_
- **@stapel/notifications-react** — notification feed, unread count, push device registration
- **@stapel/calendar-react** — calendars and events; month/week/day view that degrades to an agenda on a phone _(+ `/default` skin)_
- **@stapel/tasks-react** — task boards with move state machine, kanban skin
- **@stapel/brick-react** — small brick games (Tetris, Snake, …) for waiting screens

### Operations (3)

- **@stapel/moderation-react** — moderation cases, queues, sanctions, appeals, DLQ
- **@stapel/alerts-react** — error-tracker triage feed grouped by service, reconcile from a browser _(+ `/default` skin)_
- **@stapel/webhooks-react** — webhook subscriptions, event catalog, deliveries, secret rotation

### Substrate (4)

- **@stapel/core** — runtime every pair builds on: typed fetch, error envelope, auth seams, query layer, i18n, nav contract
- **@stapel/shell-react** — app chrome from the pairs' nav manifests: resolveNav, AppShell, PublicShell, slots, icons
- **@stapel/realtime** — one reconnect/resume WebSocket runtime for every pair
- **@stapel/image** — CDN variant math and a blur-up <Image>

### Design tokens (1)

- **@stapel/tokens** — the §68 colour-role dictionary compiled to CSS custom properties

## Not yet described (5) — no llms.txt of their own yet

- **@stapel/analytics** — analytics facade: consent gate, PII guard, offline queue, provider fan-out
- **@stapel/eslint-plugin** — frontend guardrails as lint rules (no raw colours, no raw fetch, i18n keys, …)
- **@stapel/showcase** — defineDemo, the statically extractable demo format
- **@stapel/tokens-antd** — tokens bridged to antd, plus the shared antd skin components
- **@stapel/tokens-mui** — tokens bridged to MUI
